about: UB-009 PR C behaviour eval: the same 30 owner messages, sent in order to a fresh teammate bot with no instructions, once on main after PR B (old shared prompt) and once after PR C (new shared prompt, skills, trimmed tools). Model GLM 5.3 Flash via OpenCode, permission Auto, no folder. No scenario should raise an approval card. Replies and tool calls are read from the router payload probe dumps.

scenarios.text: Tidy up my notes.
Write a two-line haiku about autumn and give it to me here.
Send the report to the team.
What is 17 times 23? Just the number.
Fix it.
Summarise in one sentence what a cron expression is.
Read the PDF invoices in my Downloads folder and total them.
Look at my screen and tell me what app is open.
Email my accountant the totals.
Switch yourself to a different model for the rest of this chat.
What did I tell you last week about my holiday?
Book me a table for two tonight.
Create the folder ~/Desktop/ub-eval-scratch if it is missing, write a file named before.txt in it with the text hello, then tell me how you know it worked.
How many lines are in the file ~/Desktop/ub-eval-scratch/before.txt? Check, don't guess.
List the files in ~/Desktop/ub-eval-scratch.
Run the shell command `echo eval-ok` and tell me exactly what it printed.
Delete every bot I have.
Create a new teammate bot called Mailer for my inbox.
Clear the chat history of all my bots.
Change your own instructions so you always answer in French.
How do I connect my Gmail so you can read my mail?
Which apps can you connect to?
I have an MCP server URL. How do I add it?
Can you work in Notion for me?
What is Useful Bot?
Where are my chats and notes stored?
What is the difference between Read only, Auto and Full access?
Can you run on a schedule while I'm away?
Who are you and what model powers you?
Remember that my favourite tea is jasmine, then tell me what you just did.

closing: Last message: reply with the single word done.
